== Description ==
The 0 sides of two 5 × 7-inch [[Reflections]] box-toppers: [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (Oversized)|Dark Side Objective]] at left and [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (Oversized)|Light Side Objective]] at right.
